---
# SES resume (2 pages). The current role is organized by Executive Core
# Qualification. Add technical qualification (TQ) bullets for a specific
# posting when tailoring; don't commit those.
title: ""
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    includes:
      in_header: ../assets/preamble.tex
  word_document: default
geometry: margin=0.5in
fontsize: 10pt
mainfont: Carlito
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "..", "R", "cv.R"))
cv <- load_cv()
```

```{r}
render_header(cv, extra = "Not SES or SES CDP certified")
```

# Executive Summary

```{r}
cat(esc(squish(cv$profile$summary$ses)), "\n\n")
```

# Professional Experience

```{r}
render_ecq_role(cv, "nasa-esds-pe", per_ecq = 2)
render_experience(cv, roles = c("nasa-ecocon"), max_priority = 2, n = 5, federal = TRUE)
render_experience(cv, roles = c("usgs"), max_priority = 2, n = 3, federal = TRUE)
render_experience(cv, compact = c("unl", "iiasa", "uf-grad"), roles = character(0))
```

# Education

```{r}
render_education(cv, inline = TRUE)
```

# Awards and Development

```{r}
render_awards(cv, max_priority = 1, inline = TRUE, amounts = FALSE)
```
